I picked the **Reading** tag and it narrowed to the two reading bookmarks, then switching **Order by** to **Title A–Z** put those two in alphabetical order — "A practical guide to focused work" ahead of "How to live with presence." So the ordering works *within* whatever I've filtered to, rather than fighting with it; the tag decides which bookmarks I see and the sort decides how they're arranged. That's exactly how I'd expect the two to work together. Good.
